note: Champaign County's parcel polygons (CCGISC TaxParcels_Assessed MapServer on gisportal.champaignil.gov) return 'Token Required' on both the folder and the layer. The CCGISC parcel data is otherwise sold by annual subscription (Products page) or per-request fee (Data Requests form). The only public ArcGIS layers found (Urbana Park_Districts, URBANA School_District) are single district-boundary polygons, not tax parcels; UIUC_Owned_Parcels covers only university-owned land. No open, queryable county-wide parcel service was found.
